description_en: Enables the transparent data encryption (TDE) feature for an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance, with support for custom keys
description_zh: 为云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例开启透明数据加密TDE功能，支持自定义密钥
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore modify-instance-tde --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --tde-status Enabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceTDE

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html to query the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Enables the transparent data encryption feature. Set the value to Enabled.
The TDE feature cannot be disabled after it is enabled. Before enabling TDE, evaluate whether it affects your business. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265913.html
parameters.help_zh:
开启TDE功能，取值：Enabled。
TDE功能开启后暂不支持关闭，开启前请评估是否影响业务。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265913.html
parameters.name: tde_status

parameters.help_en:
The encryption algorithm. Default value: AES-CTR-256.
This parameter is available only when TDEStatus is set to Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
加密算法，默认AES-CTR-256。
当TDEStatus参数取值为Enabled时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: encryption_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the custom key. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473860.html to query the key ID.

If you do not specify this parameter, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28935.html automatically generates a key.
To create a custom key, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28947.html operation of Key Management Service
parameters.help_zh:
自定义密钥ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473860.html获取。

如果不传入本参数，则由https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28935.html自动生成密钥。
如需创建自定义密钥，您可以调用密钥管理服务的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28947.html接口
parameters.name: encryption_key

parameters.help_en:
The global resource descriptor Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the role to be authorized. After the authorization is complete, the related Key Management Service can be used. Format: `acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName`.

`$accountID`: the Alibaba Cloud account ID. Log on to the Alibaba Cloud Management Console, move the mouse over the profile picture in the upper-right corner, and then click Security Settings to view the account ID.
`$roleName`: the RAM role name. Set this value to AliyunRdsInstanceEncryptionDefaultRole
parameters.help_zh:
指定待授权角色的全局资源描述符ARN（Alibaba Cloud Resource Name）信息，完成授权后即可使用相关密钥管理服务，格式：`acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName` 。

`$accountID`：云账号ID。您可以登录阿里云控制台，将鼠标悬停在右上角头像的位置，单击安全设置进行查看。
`$roleName`：RAM角色名称，取值固定为：AliyunRdsInstanceEncryptionDefaultRole
parameters.name: role_arn
